items.q: Is it safe to get dental treatment in China?
items.a: Yes. Every clinic on our platform holds a valid Chinese Medical Institution License and employs licensed dentists. We verify credentials before listing any partner.

items.q: How much can I save compared with my home country?
items.a: International patients commonly save 40–70% on implants, crowns and cosmetic work versus US, UK, Australia or Western Europe — without compromising on materials or standards.
Yes. Our coordination team and many of our dentists communicate in English via WhatsApp, email and video call throughout your journey.
Message us on WhatsApp or email with your needs and any X-rays. We'll match you with a licensed clinic and send a treatment plan with transparent price ranges.

items.q: Can I combine treatment with travel?
items.a: Absolutely — that's the point. We suggest destinations, accommodation and a relaxed itinerary around your appointments in Beijing or Guizhou.

items.q: How long will my trip take?
items.a: A check-up and clean can be a single day. Implants typically need 1–2 visits over 3–6 months; many patients split this across two trips.

items.q: What about aftercare when I go home?
items.a: You receive a full aftercare guide and digital records. Our team remains reachable on WhatsApp for follow-up questions after you return.
Prices are indicative ranges. Your final quote depends on your assessment by a licensed dentist. We are always transparent before any treatment begins.

items.q: Do I need a special medical visa?
items.a: Most travellers enter on a standard tourist (L) visa or visa-free transit where eligible. We advise checking current requirements for your nationality before booking.

items.q: Will my data and privacy be protected?
items.a: We handle your information under applicable privacy standards and only share clinical details with the clinic delivering your care, with your consent.
